identity.en: A stooped fifty-eight-year-old Chinese man, contemporary urban China, a stroke survivor retired at home
identity.text: 58 岁中国男性，脑梗后遗症，退休在家，苏晚的父亲

face.en: Deeply lined weathered face, grey hair, heavy drooping eyelids, dull tired eyes, mouth set in a patient flat line, slightly asymmetrical features with the left side of the face marginally slack, age spots on cheeks and forehead
face.text: 脸皱纹深、头发花白，眼皮沉重下垂，眼神钝而疲惫，嘴抿成一条耐心的直线，五官略不对称、左侧面部微微松弛，脸颊与额头有老年斑

hair.en: Grey hair with individual grey hairs breaking the hairline
hair.text: 花白头发，发际线有单根灰发破开

top.en: a plain worn dark jacket over a rumpled checked shirt, the jacket fabric matte and softened with years of wear
top.text: 朴素旧深色夹克，内搭皱格子衬衫，夹克面料哑光洗得发软

bottom.en: dark trousers and plain cloth shoes

details.en: the grey hair breaking the hairline
the rumpled checked shirt collar under the dark jacket
details.text: 夹克领口下皱着的格子衬衫领

details.en: the matte softened sleeve of the worn dark jacket
details.text: 洗得发软的旧夹克袖口

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
